$comment: Canonical svc enforcement gates. Each gate has a host-agnostic id and per-host MUST/MAY/SKIP requirements. The validator validate-cross-host-hook-conformance.sh greps each hook-capable host's wire script for the host-specific id pattern, and requires every skills-only host to remain outside MUST/MAY hook coverage.

skills_only_hosts.antigravity: Skills install host only. capabilities.hooks=false until svc has a verified Antigravity-specific hook wirer.
skills_only_hosts.cursor: Skills install host only. capabilities.hooks=false until svc has a verified Cursor-specific hook wirer.

gates.description: Block TaskUpdate(completed) when eval matrix unfilled (PreToolUse on TaskUpdate).

Block writes to canonical skill-output paths without recent skill receipt (G-4). Hook implementation lives in hooks/svc-skill-artifact-authenticity.mjs and is enumerated in scripts/wire-hooks.mjs as of WI-123. Other hosts MAY adopt when an equivalent hook port is written.
R-1 (WI-116): on SessionStart, scan installed skills for dangling symlinks and warn. Soft-warn only — never blocks. Wired host-agnostically via WI-123.
R-1 (WI-116): on UserPromptSubmit, warn when orchestrator-state.json references active WIs without matching lane-tasks files. Soft-warn only. Gemini does not list a UserPromptSubmit event.

R-1 (WI-116): on PreCompact (Claude/Kimi) or PreCompress (Gemini), write a session snapshot to .svc/sessions/. Observe-only. Codex CLI does not support PreCompact. OpenCode handles via session.compacted plugin event.
R-1 (WI-116): on SessionEnd, append a session record to .svc/sessions/sessions.jsonl. Observe-only. Codex CLI does not support SessionEnd.
R-1 (WI-116): on Notification, append payloads to .svc/sessions/notifications.jsonl. Observe-only. Codex CLI does not support Notification.
Block Edit|Write to linter/formatter/test-runner config files (workflow-guard default mode).

Block Edit/Write when session contract (.svc/session-contract.jsonl) is >1h old or contract.skill mismatches SVC_CURRENT_SKILL. Hard block preventing drift/ghost-completions. Origin: audit-session-execution F2 (May 6 2026).
Block Edit/Write content that extends APIs or framework patterns listed in references/deprecated-foundations.json without an explicit migrate-vs-extend acknowledgement.
